title: Northwind Health - streaming freeze troubleshooting
next_steps: Redwood to share NGINX SSE settings snippet
Customer to plan upgrade to Private v1.8.4
Customer to provide a request ID from a stuck stream if it recurs
body:
Meeting header
Date: 2025-12-04
Start time: 16:00 UTC
Duration: 34 minutes
Attendees: Vanessa Ortiz, Rohan Mehta, Dana Wu, Samir Qureshi, Mina Patel

Summary
Customer reports SSE streaming sometimes freezes mid-answer. Redwood reviews likely proxy buffering/timeout behavior and a Private version that includes a heartbeat keepalive.

Topics
- What the customer sees in the UI
- NGINX ingress buffering and timeouts
- Redwood Private version and upgrade path
- What logs/IDs to capture

Transcript
[00:00] Vanessa Ortiz: cool, thanks everyone for jumping on. you mentioned the stream kind of just stops?
[00:12] Dana Wu: yeah, exactly. it starts streaming tokens and then it like freezes. no error. our app is waiting.
[00:24] Rohan Mehta: when it freezes, do you ever see the final done marker?
[00:28] Dana Wu: no. we never get the "done" thing. we just sit there.
[00:40] Mina Patel: if we refresh we get a second response, so we try not to do that but the clinicians get stuck.
[01:05] Rohan Mehta: and this is behind your NGINX ingress, right? do you have proxy_buffering enabled?
[01:15] Dana Wu: i think yes by default. also we enabled http2 on that ingress recently.
[01:26] Rohan Mehta: yeah, that combination can be rough for SSE. you generally want `proxy_buffering off` and a higher `proxy_read_timeout`.
[01:45] Vanessa Ortiz: we have a known issue page for support that calls this out. we can share recommended settings.
[02:10] Dana Wu: is Redwood sending any keepalive? because sometimes the model pauses for a bit then the stream dies.
[02:20] Rohan Mehta: newer Private builds send a heartbeat comment line periodically if no tokens are emitted. what version are you on?
[02:35] Dana Wu: 1.8.2.
[02:40] Rohan Mehta: ok. heartbeat landed in 1.8.4. id recommend upgrading rather than a one-off patch.
[03:05] Samir Qureshi: does the heartbeat change anything from a security standpoint?
[03:10] Rohan Mehta: no, its just an SSE comment frame to keep the connection alive. no data beyond that.
[04:02] Vanessa Ortiz: next steps: well send the NGINX snippet, and you plan the 1.8.4 upgrade. if it happens again after that, please capture a request id + approximate time.
[33:20] Dana Wu: ok. that all makes sense. well try the ingress changes today and schedule the upgrade.
